title: Identity Expansion
hook: You keep hitting the goal and then sliding right back to where you were.
statement: You have to grow into the person who can actually hold your goals, or you'll keep slipping back.
explainer: Bigger revenue, a bigger team, bigger deals all need a bigger version of you. If your habits still belong to the old you, the results won't stick.
sop: Describe who you need to become. Specific, like 'closes big deals calmly,' not 'successful.'
Score your Identity Expansion and Action from 1 to 10.
List 3 things that version of you would do this week.
Do one of them today, even if it feels early.
Check in monthly. Identity grows through reps, not one decision.
equation_example: Identity Expansion 6, Action 7. 6 × 7 = 42. Higher means you can hold bigger goals without falling back into old habits. Lower means your goals are outgrowing who you are right now.
question: Write one sentence describing the person who could comfortably run the life you're building.
closing_statement: Become the person before the goal demands it.
caption:
Principle Nº 186: Identity Expansion

You keep hitting the goal and then sliding right back to where you were.
